source: T. Manzaneque, R. Lu, Y. Yang, S. Gong, "Low-loss and wideband acoustic delay lines," IEEE Trans. Microw. Theory Techn. 67(4), 1379-1391 (2019)
structure: Suspended X-cut LiNbO3, 800 nm thick; propagation at -10 deg from +Y (chosen in the paper for the largest k2); unit cell lambda0 = 20 um.
orientation: X-cut phi = -10 here (phi from +Y toward +Z). The sign is the one with the larger coupling in this tool (K2 37.8 % at -10, 24.9 % at +10).

simulated.kind: simulated (COMSOL FEM, Sec. II-C; constants not stated)
simulated.note: The paper names the open (free) velocity v_inf and the grounded-top one v0. The 100 nm Au value includes electrode mass and is not modelled here.
